description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Measurement' that models a measurement of a value over multiple time intervals, including methods to retrieve measurement type, success status, counts, and timestamps, along with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: Measurement
classes.description: A Java interface representing a measurement that includes methods to access measurement metadata, counts over durations, success status, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Measurement.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing definitions for JSON fields related to Measurement, specifically the last message timestamp.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the type of measurement, such as 'consumed' or 'mapped'.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Indicates whether the measurement represents a successful operation or a failure.

methods.name: getCounts
methods.description: Returns a map of time durations to counter values, representing counts over different intervals.

methods.name: getLastMessageAt
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the last instant when the counter was updated.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the measurement to a JsonObject including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the measurement to a JsonObject for a specified schema version and field selector.
